condition: Synthetic text typed into a fresh anonymous Chrome composer but never submitted
scope: One baseline-reset, loopback DevTools-controlled browser capture; a control of the completed-state grammar, not a false-positive-rate estimate

acquisition.host_copy_method: VMware Tools guest-file copy; no firewall rule changed

blind_process_scoped_analysis.frozen_method: FROZEN_CHROME_STATE_V1.json; all three source SHA-256 values rechecked before parsing
blind_process_scoped_analysis.process_selection: active chrome.exe processes from image-derived windows.pslist, with exact --type=renderer in windows.cmdline

later_full_physical_state_scan.method: Unchanged bounded Chrome-state grammar over the verified flat physical image, with no known turn values
later_full_physical_state_scan.scope: Retrospective format-specific physical scan, not a new capture or proof that the draft was absent

separate_posthoc_exact_byte_diagnostic.interpretation: The independently observed draft text survived, but an exact-byte hit is not a submitted message. The CDP control and its saved observations may themselves contribute copies; physical counts cannot establish application origin or a general persistence rate.

screenshots.source: Actual anonymous Chrome page before acquisition; synthetic text still in the composer

interpretation: In this capture, the frozen completed-turn grammar found no candidate while exact draft bytes remained in RAM. The evidence does not imply that every unsent draft has this result or that observed copies are independent of the instrumented controller.
